name: get_task
description: Get a task's details and comments by its MOM-label or id.

task.description: the task to fetch: its MOM-label or id

name: list_members
description: List the members of your workspace (name, email, role) so you can pick an assignee.

name: list_milestones
description: List milestones in your workspace, optionally filtered by project.

project.description: filter by project: its PRJ-label, exact name, or id

name: list_projects
description: List the projects in your workspace (PRJ-label, name, status). Use this to find the project to create a task in.

name: list_tasks
description: List tasks in your workspace, optionally filtered by project, assignee, or status. Use assignee "me" for your own tasks.

project.description: filter by project: its PRJ-label, name, or id

assignee.description: filter by assignee: me, a member name, or an email

status.description: filter by status: backlog, todo, in_progress, done, or cancelled
